SteamCMD burns ~175 s of CPU on every start here (login alone: 200 s), so on small machines it is CPU-bound before it downloads anything.
items in parallel × threads per item · server, mean of 3
All layouts are within ~12%; 3 × 3 was fastest here but uses 9 workers. PxModRim stays at 8 (2 × 4).
✓ A Python dependency, nothing to install
2.4 MB installer, then an 18 s self-update to 204 MB
Its own folder, linked into Mods with a symlink
✓ Finished mods kept, temp files removed
10 mods: Harmony, HugsLib, Vanilla Expanded Framework, Character Editor, RimHUD, Dubs Bad Hygiene,
Pick Up And Haul, Allow Tool, Numbers, Mod Manager. Both tools produced byte-identical files (115.6 MB).
Desktop: Linux, ~2.5 MB/s. Server: Ubuntu 22.04; SteamCMD Docker with persistent state, bootstrapped.
Server PxSteamDL: e097a342, ulimit -n 65536 (EMFILE at 1024). App now pins 407d2dee.
